data.long_meaning: Dharmik is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dharma', which signifies duty, righteousness, and morality. This name implies a follower of Dharma, one who upholds moral values and principles. The name Dharmik carries the meaning “Follower of Dharma” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dharmik usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of dharma and live with faith, good character and purpose.
